cadence_intersection.note: Nearest native cadence within one third exposure; QLP and cutout barycentric timestamps differ by tens of seconds, retained explicitly.

background_scheme: Median of native reference-faintest quartile pixels, optionally subtracted from every pixel. Approximate median uncertainty added diagonally; induced covariance not fully modeled.
limitations: Selected ephemeris; native pixel regressions are conditional, not a calibrated confidence region.
Diagonal errors with event-scatter floor do not model all spacecraft covariance.
Gaussian shape is not a calibrated TESS PRF; no proper-motion correction or crowding deblend.
A displaced difference does not exclude a weaker overlapping on-target transit.
A fitted position with low image S/N or a Gaussian width bound is explicitly invalid for source localization.
